title: Witness evaluator: bundle -> P-FLAT, binding, custody, artifact re-hash, predicates, outcome class per subject
objective: rso/witness/evaluate.py: read a committed witness bundle; apply P-FLAT and the rso.binding checks (BX1, BX2, BX5b) against the anchored manifest; require custody QUALIFIED for qualification; re-hash every artifact against its receipt; recompute episode decisions and counts from the bytes; evaluate P-CAL, P-OBS, P-ERASE, P-PRES, P-RET, P-CHAN with rso/witness/ruler.py; map to the s6 outcome class per subject; emit a canonical RESULT record. No field the producer computed is trusted.
problem: Tests on synthetic bundles you construct (fake action arrays with known counts; hand-wired organisms if useful) -- never a registered subject or arm. Cover every s6 class and every gate's FAIL path, P-FLAT refusals (nested parent, digestless COMPLETED row, duplicate node), artifact mismatch, custody UNQUALIFIED.
non_goals: No subject GA run and no witness episode before FREEZE_W1 and the challenge (PREREGISTRATION s10)
No accuracy / retention / reward statistic on any registered arm before the witness launches
No edit of ares/ sources; no change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane
evidence_required: every outcome class and every gate FAIL path tested on synthetic bundles

acceptance.command: python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/witness/tests -t . && python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/binding/tests -t .

authority: operator directive 2026-10-07 (C-004-OP8) s6: native witness opens automatically when C-009 closes; rso/binding/CLOSURE.md
